prior_status: A052 had an exact child-ratio slack identity and a lower persistence theorem for U on random restriction frontiers, but no independently derived upper-set envelope or coordinate-local asymmetry witness.
new_status: An all-dimensional phase-free Jensen envelope and exact coordinate charge decomposition are proved. Combined with persistence, high-ratio maximizers force a physical coordinate with normalized conditional-absence surprisal at least R/4-O(1). Pending independent review; full FEI remains open.
mathematical_delta: Introduced F_t(p), proved E U(f_{J,X})<=F_t(p), decomposed F_t into nonnegative coordinate absence-surprise charges, and extracted a quantitative useful-coordinate condition for fixed-n H/I maximizers while retaining terminal variance and empty-coefficient entropy.
class_extension: The envelope holds for all genuine Boolean functions in all dimensions and every retention t; the structural witness applies to every finite-dimensional ratio maximizer.
previous_bound: Only a lower persistence bound on expected U/I was available.
new_bound: For t=1/2, some coordinate satisfies C_i/p_i >= F_{1/2}/I >= (R-2)/4-1/(2 ln 2) plus nonnegative normalized terminal terms.

finite_verification.scope: All 65812 Boolean truth tables through n=4, including 65804 nonconstant functions; named point-defect, disjoint near-tensor, fresh-selector, and parity controls.
finite_verification.limitations: Diagnostic only; the proof artifact supplies the all-dimensional argument.

remaining_obstacle: No universal K is known for max_i C_i(1/2)/p_i<=K on every ratio-critical Boolean spectrum. An existential low-charge coordinate would not pair with the high-charge witness; without a maximum-coordinate upper payment, the useful-coordinate lower witness does not bound R.
next_action: Combine the all-block erasure inequalities and signed Boolean convolution constraints to bound the maximum coordinate charge max_i C_i(1/2)/p_i on critical spectra, or construct a genuine Boolean critical family falsifying such a bound.

delivery_status.readback_method: All seven remote Git blob SHAs matched git hash-object of the local artifacts in both repositories.
